title: 虫のこえ (Mushi no Koe — Voices of Insects)
description: A Meiji-era school song celebrating the autumn insect chorus: pine crickets (ちんちろりん), bell crickets (りんりん), field crickets (きりきり), saddled caterpillars (がちゃがちゃ), and katydids (すいっちょん). Selected as one of Japan's 100 Songs of Cultural Heritage.
